description: This file defines a mock class `MockAuthUser` used in unit testing for the OrangeHRM project. It extends the real `User` class and overrides methods to throw exceptions, indicating they should not be called during tests. It serves as a testing utility within the `OrangeHRM\Tests\Util\Mock` namespace.
